laws.rule: Paraná environmental agency IAT says Ordinance 169/2026 prohibits recreational drones of any class, including those under 250 g, in IAT-administered integral-protection conservation units.

Paraná IAT says commercial use of images of state conservation units is regulated under Ordinance 76/2026 and requires the stated authorisation process; uses that are not commercial do not need prior IAT authorisation under this image-use process.
At Paraná’s Vila Velha State Park, the park authority lists consuming alcohol as prohibited.
At Paraná’s Vila Velha State Park, camping, campfires and barbecues are prohibited, and visitors must not leave marked trails.
At Paraná’s Mata São Francisco State Park, the park authority prohibits pets and feeding, capturing or disturbing wildlife, as well as collecting plants or other natural resources.

laws.heading: Lei 16.239/2009
laws.rule: Paraná state Lei 16.239/2009 bans smoking cigarettes, cigarillos, cigars, pipes and any other smoking product, tobacco or not, in shared spaces, public or private (workplaces, schools, bars, restaurants, theatres, shopping centres, public transport and taxis). Using e-cigarettes is also banned, and since Lei 21.520/2023 hookah (narguilé) is named too. Smoking is also banned in a vehicle carrying children or pregnant women. Exceptions: religious rites that use smoke, patients a doctor has cleared to smoke in health facilities, public roads, homes, and venues made only for on-site smoking and signed at the entrance. A person who smokes is warned, then asked to leave, with police help if needed.
laws.penalty_signal: fine of 100 UPF/PR for the venue or person responsible (doubled for a repeat); enforced by state sanitary surveillance

laws.heading: Lei 22.315/2025 (Ilha do Mel)
laws.rule: Paraná state Lei 22.315 of 20 March 2025 makes Ilha do Mel (in Paranaguá Bay) a region of special environmental and tourism interest. Article 30 caps visitors at 11,049 a day: up to 5,903 through the Brasília terminal and 5,146 through Encantadas, and the island's managing unit can lower the cap for weather or safety. Article 46 creates an entry-and-stay charge for visitors, to be set by an Instituto Água e Terra (IAT) rule; people exempt under other laws stay exempt. In February 2026 the state said the price was not yet set, the ticket would be one charge valid for up to ten days, and residents, some children and service providers would be exempt. The law also leaves pets, sound equipment in public places, street trading and electric vehicles to later IAT rules (art. 51). Check the IAT for the amount and start date before travel.
laws.penalty_signal: entry-and-stay charge; amount to be set by IAT
